movement_profile.arms_and_hands: holding a pair of wooden sticks
movement_profile.footwork: steps forward to hit sticks with partner, then moves on two people
movement_profile.formation_and_space: two lines, partners facing each other, moving clockwise
movement_profile.partnering: dancers operate in pairs, requiring an even number of participants

signature_moves.description: hitting sticks with partner or self to mark time
signature_moves.name: stick-clashing

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by a rhythmic clattering of sticks marking time, starting slowly and building in intensity.

basic_steps: Hold one stick in each hand
Hit own sticks together on beat 1
Hit right stick with partner on beat 2
Hit left stick with partner on beat 3
Turn away to the left and hit own sticks together
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the 8-beat cycle and partner synchronization.
